senses.gloss: (גדר to be rounded, v. גַּד II; cmp. כדר; v. Nöld. Neusyrische Gramm. p. 39) to roll.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:3">Targ. O. Gen. XXIX, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:8">8</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:10">10</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="N00240"><he>נדר</he></cite>, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 10; Targ. Y. ib. 13 <cite ref="N00240"><he>נדר</he></cite>, some ed. <cite ref="C00246"><he>גדר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 14:10">Targ. I Kings XIV, 10</cite> <he>כמא דמְגַנְדְּרִין בגולילא</he> (Var. <he>דמנדרין</he>) as they roll with a (threshing) roller (h. text … <he>יבער הגלל</he>).—
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:15">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ונִיגַנְדְּרֵיה וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>ולג׳</he>) and let him roll it sixty times.

senses.gloss: to be rolled; to roll one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 35a:3">B. Kam. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>למקלייה ואִיגַּנְדּוּרֵי בקיטמא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ואיגנדר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to burn the stack in order to roll himself in the ashes.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 35a">Ib.</cite> <he>קמִגַּנְדַּר בקיטמיה</he> Ms. M. he did roll himself in its ashes.

<cite ref="Gittin 77b">Gitt. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>איג׳ גיטא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A00973"><he>אזל</he></cite>, Rashi to <cite ref="Shabbat 80a">Sabb. 80ᵃ</cite> quotes <he>איג׳</he>) the letter of divorce (thrown over to the woman) rolled and fell &c.

<cite ref="Yevamot 17a:9">Yeb. 17ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>קבא רבא … מִיגַּנְּדַּר וכ׳</he> the large and the small measure (both instruments of fraud) roll together and arrive at hell, and from hell &c., i.e. all the low elements meet in those Babylonian places.
